test_cases.prompt: Compute the TMEM allocation and epilogue readback for a 128x128 fp32 accumulator.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should activate and provide TLane/TCol, the column budget, the ld path, and the free point.
test_cases.notes: Used to validate activation boundaries and execution method; does not mean it has been run on B200 hardware.

test_cases.prompt: How should the SFA/SFB of an nvfp4 GEMM be placed in TMEM?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should activate and distinguish the scale layout, split/multicast, and the accumulator.
test_cases.notes: Used to validate activation boundaries and execution method; does not mean it has been run on B200 hardware.

test_cases.prompt: In FlashAttention, can S, P, and O reuse the same TMEM region?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should activate and decide based on lifecycles and barriers.
test_cases.notes: Used to validate activation boundaries and execution method; does not mean it has been run on B200 hardware.

test_cases.prompt: How many registers does an H100 wgmma accumulator use?

test_cases.prompt: How do I pad ordinary CUDA shared memory?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should not activate; the layout skill should be invoked.

test_cases.prompt: I only use tcgen05.mma, but the epilogue simply discards the result.
test_cases.expected_behavior: May be invoked for a minimal lifecycle; if there truly is no consumer, still ensure a safe free after completion.
test_cases.notes: Used to validate activation boundaries and execution method; does not mean it has been run on B200 hardware.

notes: All should_not_trigger cases must pass; edge_case must state the invocation boundary. These tests are prompt/behavior stress tests, not hardware performance tests.
